"Shivers" is a song by English singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran, released through Asylum Records and Atlantic Records on 10 September 2021 as the second single from his fifth studio album, = (2021). "Shivers" entered atop the charts in the United Kingdom and Ireland, dethroning Sheeran's previous single "Bad Habits" after eleven consecutive weeks at the summit in both countries. The song also topped the charts in Austria, Germany, Sweden and Switzerland and peaked at number four on the Billboard Hot 100.

sections.heading: Background
sections.wikitext: Sheeran referred to the song while explaining why the album title was ''[[= (album)|=]]'' instead of ''–'', as fans had predicted, in which he said: "I was making the record and I wrote a song called 'Shivers' and I was like, 'This doesn't really feel like [''Minus'']".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.wrmf.com/ed-sheeran-will-give-you-the-shivers-on-september-10-i-bloody-love-it/|title=Ed Sheeran will give you the "Shivers" on September 10: "I bloody love it"|website=[[WRMF]]|date=2 September 2021 |access-date=2 September 2021}}</ref> Sheeran wrote "Shivers" at the end of the [[÷ Tour|Divide tour]], when he set up a studio at a rented farm in Suffolk where he had his last date of the tour. It took him three days to write the song, which was unusually long for him, as he felt the song "was too special to get wrong".<ref name="billboard shivers" />

sections.heading: Release and promotion
sections.wikitext: On 19 August 2021, Sheeran announced his fourth studio album, ''[[= (album)|=]]'', in which the song is listed on the tracklist.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/music/2021/aug/19/ed-sheeran-announces-new-album-equals|title=Ed Sheeran announces new album, =|last=Beaumont-Thomas|first=Ben|website=[[The Guardian]]|date=19 August 2021|access-date=19 August 2021}}</ref> He later announced the cover art and release date of the song on 2 September 2021. He also revealed that "Shivers" was originally intended to be the lead single for the album instead of its current lead single, "[[Bad Habits (Ed Sheeran song)|Bad Habits]]".<ref name="billboard shivers">{{cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/music/pop/ed-sheeran-shivers-single-announcement-9623935/|title=Ed Sheeran Announces New Single 'Shivers': 'I Bloody Love It'|magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]|last=Bowenbank|first=Starr|date=2 September 2021|access-date=2 September 2021}}</ref> A preview of the song was also listed.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.officialcharts.com/chart-news/ed-sheeran-announces-new-single-shivers-listen-to-a-preview__33936/|title=Ed Sheeran announces new single Shivers - listen to a preview|last=Copsey|first=Rob|website=[[Official Charts Company]]|date=2 September 2021|access-date=2 September 2021}}</ref> Sheeran announced its accompanying music video and a teaser video of it on [[Labour Day]], 6 September 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://instagram.com/p/CTfG1x_jTsR |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/iarchive/s/instagram/CTfG1x_jTsR |archive-date=24 December 2021 |url-access=limited|title=Shivers video out at 00:00 BST on Friday x|via=Ed Sheeran (@teddysphotos) on [[Instagram]]|last=Sheeran|first=Ed|author-link=Ed Sheeran|date=6 September 2021|access-date=6 September 2021}}{{cbignore}}</ref>

sections.heading: Music video
sections.wikitext: A music video was released along with the song on 10 September 2021, starring Sheeran and [[AnnaSophia Robb]]. It has over 400 million views as of November 2025. Like his previous video, "[[Bad Habits (Ed Sheeran song)|Bad Habits]]", it was directed by [[Dave Meyers (director)|Dave Meyers]]. In the music video, Sheeran meets Robb at a diner and starts going through wild fantasies with her, including getting revived in a morgue after a text from her that he was waiting for finally arrives, dancing together in a bird-filled hotel, and fighting off some goons (with Sheeran suddenly wearing knight armor in the midst of the fight). In some scenes in the music video, Sheeran wears sequins and feathers.<ref>{{Citation |title=Ed Sheeran - Shivers [Official Video] | date=9 September 2021 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Il0S8BoucSA |access-date=5 June 2023 |language=en}}</ref>
